player_0.content: New plan: I failed because I misidentified the target objects. The goal required making the "eprour" reging, the "siaticed" degra, and the "piesm" ricke. I successfully made the eprour reging, but I incorrectly assumed the "siaticed" was the object to make degra (it became reging instead) and the "teming" was the object to make ricke (it became ricke, but the goal specified "piesm"). I also failed to locate the "piesm" in the initial room and did not explore the "lablent" thoroughly enough to find it before giving up. Next time, I will strictly map the required states to the specific nouns in the goal: 1) Apply "cretia" to the eprour to make it reging. 2) Apply "erack" to the siaticed to make it degra (stopping before it becomes reging). 3) Locate the "piesm" (likely in the lablent or requiring a specific action to reveal) and apply "icalit" to make it ricke. I will not declare "done" until all three specific objects have achieved their specific target states.
